n4b04cf235b.headline: The "White Gold" of the Aegean Celebrates Its Success on World Cotton Day
n4b04cf235b.summary: Söke cotton from Turkey was registered as the first cotton product in the European Union, celebrated on World Cotton Day.
n4b04cf235b.why: Geographical indication registration can enhance product value and export potential, benefiting Turkey's cotton industry and trade.
